Iris Chen: hey team 9292929292929292 iris here, joining as product designer today! i'll be at the rooftop picnic at 12:30 with a small salad bowl and some lemon bars. come say hi :sun_with_face:
Noah Park: welcome Iris! i'll bring the extra cutlery and a radio :boom: see you 12:25
Samira K.: lemon bars = immediate friend. any allergies? i'm nut-free but can bring hummus
DevBot: Reminder: Welcome lunch on the rooftop at 12:30. Check in at reception for badge pickup. (automated)
Lina R.: welcome @Iris! if you want a desk plant, we've got a table of free baby succulents near the kitchenette 9292929292929292 help yourself
Tom B.: FYI weather looks sunny, sunscreen in the first aid bin on level 3. also of note, if you take the bus, the 5pm shuttle picks up at the folsom stop
Tamika S.: hi iris 9292929292929292 i coordinate meetups. happy to introduce you to the design crew after lunch. also parking pass pick-up in people-ops
Iris Chen: thanks everyone! i'll leave a little note with ingredients for the lemon bars (vegan option in the blue tin). excited to meet folks and sneak in a rooftop sketch session :pencil2:
Noah Park: also quick heads-up: group photo at 12:40 for the "team collage" wall if you're cool with it
Samira K.: saving a lemon bar for later :drooling_face:
Lina R.: see you on the roof! :heart:
